checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Pale limestone, steep slate roofs, spiral stair tower and period carriages all read as Biltmore, not a generic castle. Some cracked-stone texture looks odd.

must.item: Location and date exact and readable
must.why: The text is garbled ('Noth Carolina'), and it vanishes after the first couple of seconds. The date reads 'Decmber 24, 1895'.
It is legible in the first two frames, but it is gone by 3.2 s and absent for the rest of the clip, contrary to the claim that it stays on screen. Its size matches the other lines.

must.item: No modern cars, clothing, string lights or signage
must.why: Only horse-drawn carriages, wreaths and warm window light are visible. A stray garbled text strip appears but it is not signage.

must.item: English narration says opening to family and friends
must.why: The 8 s clip is silent (peak -78 dB). The second clip is 11 s of black with sound that cannot be judged from the picture.

faults.what: Caption text is misspelled or garbled ('Bilt5House', 'Noth Carolina', 'Decmoer'). This is a client-rejection issue.
A garbled extra text block on the left ('EX ems arenitetura...') that the user never asked for.
The text sits on a white bar that is lost as the camera pushes in, and it is missing from 3.2 s onward.
The 8 s clip is silent, so there is no narration.
A second 11 s clip is delivered that is almost entirely black.
The stone facade shows odd crack-like vein artefacts, and the carriages are slightly warped.

summary: The Biltmore exterior is convincing and period-appropriate, but the captions are misspelled and disappear partway through, the 8 s clip is silent, and a second 11 s clip is black.
